hook: In 2004, Google's email was about to transform tech forever.
body: Back then, email felt like a solved problem. Yet, an engineer named Aaron Swartz saw its potential. He introduced Gmail’s search feature, revolutionizing how we find emails. This simple change turned Gmail into the world’s most used email service and inspired innovation in other apps by Google. It's not just about email; it's about how tech can evolve to meet user needs.
cta: Clone this repo or follow for more on Google's Email Renaissance.
